channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10

about.description:
liquibase-postgresql extends the Liquibase database schema change
management and migration tool with additional PostgreSQL-specific
change types (such as VACUUM and COPY). It ships as a single JAR that
Liquibase auto-loads from its global library directory, so installing
this package alongside `liquibase` is enough to enable it; no
additional configuration is required.
about.summary: Liquibase extension adding additional PostgreSQL-specific functionality

name: liquibase-postgresql
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "5.0.4"

package:
  name: liquibase-postgresql
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase-postgresql/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cadba5a2cfa6a1ddd172d4801ef39ed9295154fa5634dd2a351b474de3e802e5

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  script:
    file: build.sh

requirements:
  build:
    - maven
    - openjdk 17.*
    - git
  run:
    - openjdk >=17
    # The extension jar is compiled against, and only supported with, the
    # matching liquibase-core release (liquibase.version in pom.xml).
    - liquibase ==${{ version }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      files:
        exists:
          - share/liquibase/lib/liquibase-postgresql-${{ version }}.jar
  - requirements:
      run:
        - ripgrep
    script:
      env:
        LIQUIBASE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED: "false"
      content:
        # Match on the filename only: Java prints the library path with the
        # platform separator, so "lib/..." would not match on Windows.
        - liquibase --version | rg --fixed-strings "liquibase-postgresql-${{ version }}.jar"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase-postgresql
  summary: Liquibase extension adding additional PostgreSQL-specific functionality
  description: |
    liquibase-postgresql extends the Liquibase database schema change
    management and migration tool with additional PostgreSQL-specific
    change types (such as VACUUM and COPY). It ships as a single JAR that
    Liquibase auto-loads from its global library directory, so installing
    this package alongside `liquibase` is enough to enable it; no
    additional configuration is required.
  license: FSL-1.1-ALv2
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - aggregate-third-party-report.html
  documentation: https://docs.liquibase.com
  repository: https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase-postgresql

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pb01ka
